 What time is it anyway?! ⏰😂 Leah Rizzo and Charlie Sokaitis are talking all things Daylight Saving Time and the confusion that comes with changing our clocks! From gaining an extra hour of sleep to adjusting to those earlier sunsets, the CoastLife hosts discuss the annual time change and whether everyone remembered to fall back! Meanwhile, Kendall Gordon heads out into the community to put Delmarva to the test! Did everyone remember to reset their clocks, or are some people still living an hour ahead? From hilarious responses to a little time-related confusion, find out who's on schedule and who's still trying to catch up! 🕰️🍂
